headline: King's Cage Ignites In Fierce Fighting As Island Fronts Shift
war_summary: Since the previous edition, King's Cage has erupted into a furious battleground, recording over 3,200 casualties in the last two hours alongside three rapid base transitions around Den of Knaves. Island fighting remains volatile in Fisherman's Row, which logged seven base exchanges in the past two hours across Dankana Post and Fort Ember, while Tempest Island flared up with three fresh shifts at Isle of Psyche. Along the eastern line, Stlican Shelf continues its heavy clash with two recent captures at The South Wind amid accelerating casualty rates. Strategic maneuvering persists in the Linn of Mercy with two recent transitions near Fort Duncan and Lathair, even as the wider regional pace moderates from earlier peaks. Meanwhile, massive attritional grinders in the Dead Lands and Weathered Expanse continue to claim thousands of troops without immediate territorial change, and Marban Hollow reports escalating losses under sustained contact. Earlier flashpoints in Stonecradle and Lykos Isle have largely cooled following midday engagements.
